verdict.rationale: iTerm2 is a GUI terminal app, but it does support scripted automation. Its Python API offers full control (gh-15, docs-13, corroborated by comm-5), and AppleScript can launch the app and open sessions from stand-alone scripts (docs-14). Nothing shows it running without a GUI or inside CI pipelines, so this is automation of the desktop app rather than true headless execution. Missing for 10: a headless or no-GUI run mode, documented CI usage, and independent hands-on evidence of unattended or CI automation.
